constraints:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS color_dye_currency (
                        user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                        color_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                        value INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                        PRIMARY KEY (user_id, color_name)
                    )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS item_dye (
                user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                unlock_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                upgrade_dye TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                created_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                PRIMARY KEY (user_id, unlock_name)
            )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS boat_follow (
                    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    creator TEXT NOT NULL,
                    nickname TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                    last_modified TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                    PRIMARY KEY (user_id, creator)
                )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS response_override (
                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                    user_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                    path TEXT NOT NULL,
                    body TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                    enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
                    updated_at TEXT,
                    UNIQUE(user_id, path)
                )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS request_log (
                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                    user_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                    path TEXT NOT NULL,
                    method TEXT,
                    status_code INTEGER,
                    body_resp TEXT,
                    updated_at TEXT,
                    UNIQUE(user_id, path)
                )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_activity (
                    user_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    last_seen INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
                )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS status_unlock_deleted (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
            name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
            deleted_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
            UNIQUE(user_id, name)
        )
